page.overview:
What is 3250 Orange Grove Avenue?

The Wallace residence is the household of the Wallace family, consisting of Lindsey Wallace and her parents. It is located at 1537 Orange Grove Avenue.

On Halloween 1978, there were three murders that took place that night within the Wallace residence. They were Lindsey's babysitter, Annie Brackett and her friends, Lynda Van Der Klok and Bob Simms, who were all victims of Michael Myers. The family dog, Lester, was also killed by Michael Myers.
